title: The Difficult Man
description: As Rey spends time with the sacred Jedi texts, the Millennium Falcon returns from its mission. Rey runs off to greet them, but immediately notices that the Falcon has sustained quite a bit of damage as a result of Poe's risky lightspeed skipping! Rey berates the pilot for the skipping and for the damage, but Poe fires back, noting BB-8's post-treefall condition.
